g.text: CreateDeployment: subdomain (generated, or the tenant's, unchecked); AllocatePort; seal env; register CIDs
primary replica row (active); A record for the home node
SelectReplicaNodes; goroutine: pending row, then POST replica/setup (concurrent with Start)
stage env, bind port, token, limits; enable; start
WaitForHealthy (unit active, up to 60 or 90 s)
setup: allocate port, extract, start; replica row active + port
on the setup answer: row active + replica A record
